build_cuda_extension: build the alt_cuda_corr CUDA extension module from correlation.cpp and correlation_kernel.cu sources
install_correlation_package: install the correlation package by running pip install in the alt_cuda_corr directory
review_setup_py: review the setup.py to understand the CUDA extension build configuration and compile flags
refactor_compile_args: refactor the setup.py to add or modify extra compile arguments for cxx or nvcc
summarize_cuda_extension: summarize the CUDAExtension configuration including source files and optimization flags
